interface.name: cutefish_window_hints_v1
interface.description: Clients may set hints only on their own surfaces. Hints are immediate metadata, independent of wl_surface.commit, and persist until replaced or the surface is destroyed. Destroying the manager does not reset them. Set initial hints before the first buffer commit to avoid task-list flashes. These hints grant no focus or privileged shell role.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a value is out of range

enum.name: placement_edge

description.summary: a side or corner of a rectangle

enum.description: The values and meanings of xdg_positioner's anchor and gravity.

request.name: set_skip_taskbar

description.summary: exclude a surface from application presentation

request.description: A value of 1 excludes the window from the dock and window switcher and preserves the previous status bar application context when focused. A value of 0 restores normal policy and is the default. Keyboard focus and input are unaffected. The compositor may also exclude windows by role.

request.name: set_always_on_top

description.summary: keep a window above ordinary application windows

request.description: A value of 1 stacks the window above ordinary application windows, and still below the shell's panels, dock and system dialogs. A value of 0 restores normal stacking and is the default. Only application windows are affected; activation and focus are unchanged.

request.name: set_resize_anchor

description.summary: choose the point a client resize keeps in place

request.description: When the client changes the size of a normal window on its own, with a new buffer or window geometry rather than in answer to a configure, the compositor keeps this point of the window where it was and then keeps the window inside the work area. Resizes the compositor initiates, interactive resizes and maximized, fullscreen or tiled windows are unaffected. top_left is the default.

request.name: set_server_resize

description.summary: let the compositor resize a client-decorated window

request.description: A value of 1 makes the compositor own resize handles along the edges of a resizable normal window that draws its own frame: they reach a few pixels outside the window, follow its rounded outline, set the cursor and start an interactive resize when pressed. Use it instead of drawing edge handles and calling xdg_toplevel.resize. A value of 0 is the default.

request.name: set_restore_id

description.summary: reopen a window where it was last left

request.description: A non-empty id makes the compositor remember where a normal window was when it unmapped, for the rest of the session. The next window of the same application, by xdg_toplevel app_id, that maps with the same id opens there on the same output and inside its work area: its centre goes back to the remembered centre with the center resize anchor, its top-left corner otherwise. Set it before the first commit. An empty id is the default and remembers nothing.

request.name: set_restore_size

description.summary: the size a window first shown maximized returns to

request.description: When a window maps maximized or fullscreen, the compositor has no normal size of its own to return it to. A non-empty size, in surface coordinates, makes such a window return to a window geometry of this size when it leaves that state, placed as a normal window of that size mapping at the same time would have been. Set it before the first commit. 0x0 is the default and leaves the choice to the compositor; a negative width or height is an invalid_value error.

request.name: set_placement_anchor

description.summary: open a window next to a point on the screen

request.description: Places a normal window next to a rectangle given in the compositor's global logical coordinates, such as the point a status notifier item receives with Activate. Each time the window maps, its outer bounds are placed as an xdg_positioner with this anchor rectangle, anchor and gravity places a popup, inside the work area of the output that holds the rectangle's centre: a window that does not fit flips to the other side of the rectangle, then slides into the work area. A width and height of 0 make the rectangle a point. This takes precedence over set_restore_id and the compositor's own placement; windows with a transient parent, maximized and fullscreen windows are unaffected, and the user moves the window freely once it is shown. A negative width or height or an unknown edge is an invalid_value error.

request.name: unset_placement_anchor

description.summary: let the compositor place the window again

request.description: The window maps where the compositor places it, as before any set_placement_anchor. This is the default.

request.name: set_body_shape

description.summary: the outline a window draws its body in

request.description: For a normal window that draws a body of its own outline inside a transparent surface, such as a bubble with an arrow: the compositor neither clips the window to its rounded rectangle nor outlines it, and the window's shadow is cast by this outline instead of its rectangle. path is in surface-local logical pixels, encoded as cutefish_surface_blur_v1.set_shape's path. Applies at once and persists until replaced; an empty array is the same as unset_body_shape. A malformed path is an invalid_value error.

request.name: unset_body_shape

description.summary: the window's body is its rectangle again

request.description: The compositor clips, outlines and shadows the window as its rounded rectangle, the default.

request.name: set_shadow

description.summary: whether the compositor casts the window's shadow

request.description: A value of 0 casts no shadow for the window, as for a client that draws its own shadow inside a transparent surface; with a body shape, such a window shows exactly as the client drew it. A value of 1 restores the compositor's policy and is the default. Applies at once and persists until replaced.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: The window, its frame and shadow included, is drawn at this opacity, from 0 to 1. At 0 it is unseen but still stacked and still takes input; a window that should be neither seen nor clicked is unmapped. 1 is the default. Applies at once and persists until replaced; a value outside 0 to 1 is an invalid_value error.

request.name: hide_application

description.summary: hide every window of the surface's application

request.description: Hides the windows of the application the surface belongs to, the way the status bar's hide item does: they leave the screen without being minimized, and the application's dock item or activation brings them back. Windows that skip the taskbar are unaffected.

event.name: interactive_resize

description.summary: an interactive resize started or ended

event.description: Sent with active 1 when the user starts resizing one of the client's windows by an edge or corner, and with active 0 when the resize ends, before the xdg_toplevel.configure that drops the resizing state. A client can tell a size the user chose from one it was given this way.

event.name: work_area

description.summary: the part of an output windows are laid out in

event.description: An output, by its wl_output name, less what the desktop's panels and dock reserve, in the compositor's global logical coordinates, where xdg_output places the output itself. primary is 1 for the primary output, the one with the status bar, and 0 for the others. Sent for every output when the manager is bound, and again for an output whose work area or primary flag changes; an output going away is announced by its wl_output global alone.
